title: 滑动确认
eyebrow: 物理位移承诺 · 临界阈值与防误触门禁
eyebrowEn: Displacement Commitment · Threshold Gate & Slip Prevention
summary: 高危不可逆操作，如何用连续物理位移杜绝误触疲劳？滑动确认强制用户执行一段具有明确矢量方向的物理行程，未达阈值松手弹性回退，超过判定阈值才完成破坏性承诺。
summaryEn: High-stakes irreversible actions require continuous physical displacement. Sliding a thumb across a directional track with progressive damping and spring rollback prevents confirmation fatigue and accidental clicks.
asks: 高危不可逆操作，如何用连续物理位移杜绝误触疲劳？
asksEn: How should critical irreversible actions use continuous physical displacement to prevent modal fatigue misclicks?

links.when: 连续物理位移滑块是极限不可逆门禁，不同于模态弹窗与点击阶梯
links.whenEn: continuous displacement slider is extreme irreversible gate, unlike modal or click steps

links.when: 滑动确认是单向单一阈值防误触门禁，列表侧滑是多动作就近露出与全滑触发
links.whenEn: slide-confirm is a single threshold safeguard, while swipe-action exposes item actions

links.when: 滑动确认是标量位移承诺，拖拽提交是空间落位与列表重排
links.whenEn: slide-confirm is scalar travel commitment, while drag-commit is spatial drop reordering
